lessons.title: Qu'est-ce que je ressens?
lessons.oneGoal: Students will identify and name basic emotions (happy, sad, angry, scared) in French

then.ifTooAdvanced: Focus only on 'content' and 'triste' with lots of visual support
then.ifNotEngaged: More movement, puppet interaction, and silly faces
then.ifSensitive: Use only puppet sharing, no personal sharing pressure

lessons.realWorldConnection: Knowing how we feel helps us tell parents, teachers, and friends what we need

lessons.title: Mon visage montre mes émotions
lessons.oneGoal: Students will recognize emotions in facial expressions and connect faces to feelings

then.ifTooAdvanced: Focus on clear happy/sad faces only with simple pointing
then.ifNotEngaged: More mirror play, silly face games
then.ifSensitive: Use cartoon faces instead of real photos if preferred

lessons.realWorldConnection: Reading faces helps us know when friends need help or want to play

lessons.title: Mon corps ressent aussi
lessons.oneGoal: Students will identify where emotions are felt in the body (heart racing, tight tummy, etc.)

then.ifTooAdvanced: Focus only on heart and happy feelings
then.ifNotEngaged: More stethoscope time, silly body movements
then.ifSensitive: Use only marionnette body, no personal body references

lessons.realWorldConnection: When our body tells us we're worried, we can ask for help or take deep breaths

lessons.title: Toutes les émotions sont normales
lessons.oneGoal: Students will understand that all emotions are normal and acceptable to feel

then.ifTooAdvanced: Focus on 'all feelings are OK' with simple examples
then.ifNotEngaged: More interactive activities with the emotion box
then.ifSensitive: Extra validation and reassurance about normalcy

lessons.realWorldConnection: When we accept our emotions, we feel better about ourselves and can get help easier

lessons.title: Dire mes sentiments
lessons.oneGoal: Students will practice expressing emotions using simple French phrases

then.ifTooAdvanced: Focus on 'content' and 'triste' expressions only
then.ifNotEngaged: More telephone play and puppet conversations
then.ifSensitive: Use only puppet expressing, no personal pressure

lessons.realWorldConnection: When we tell people how we feel, they can help us or celebrate with us

lessons.title: Quand je suis content
lessons.oneGoal: Students will explore positive emotions and appropriate ways to express joy

then.ifTooAdvanced: Focus on simple 'content' vs 'très content'
then.ifNotEngaged: More bubbles, simpler activities
then.ifOverstimulated: Calmer activities, more breathing, less stimulation

lessons.realWorldConnection: Showing joy appropriately helps us share happiness with others without overwhelming them

lessons.title: Quand je suis triste
lessons.oneGoal: Students will learn healthy ways to cope with sadness and seek comfort

then.ifTooAdvanced: Focus on 'triste' and 'câlin' with comfort items
then.ifNotEngaged: More comfort box exploration
then.ifTriggering: More puppet focus, less personal examples, more comfort available

lessons.realWorldConnection: When we're sad, asking for comfort helps us feel better and shows others how to help us

lessons.title: Quand je suis fâché
lessons.oneGoal: Students will learn appropriate ways to express and manage anger

then.ifTooAdvanced: Focus on 'fâché' and breathing only
then.ifNotEngaged: More hands-on with cushions and bottles
then.ifTriggering: More puppet examples, immediate calming activities

lessons.realWorldConnection: Learning to handle anger safely keeps us and others safe and helps solve problems

lessons.title: Quand j'ai peur
lessons.oneGoal: Students will identify fears and learn strategies to feel brave and seek help

then.ifTooAdvanced: Focus on 'peur' and 'demander aide' with simple examples
then.ifNotEngaged: More courage props and superhero play
then.ifTriggering: Less fear talk, more courage building and adult help focus

lessons.realWorldConnection: Being brave means we can try new things, and asking for help keeps us safe

lessons.title: Respirer pour me calmer
lessons.oneGoal: Students will learn simple breathing exercises to self-regulate emotions

then.ifTooAdvanced: Focus on simple 'in, out' breathing with counting
then.ifNotEngaged: More interactive props, less sitting still
then.ifOverstimulating: Simpler breathing, less props, more calm environment

lessons.realWorldConnection: Deep breathing helps us feel calmer anywhere - at home, school, or playing

lessons.title: Comprendre les autres
lessons.oneGoal: Students will begin to recognize and respond to emotions in others

then.ifTooAdvanced: Focus on 'ami triste' and 'être gentil'
then.ifNotEngaged: More mirror play and heart giving

lessons.realWorldConnection: Understanding others helps us be better friends and makes everyone feel good

lessons.title: Aider un ami triste
lessons.oneGoal: Students will learn how to comfort and support friends who are upset

then.ifTooAdvanced: Focus on 'ami triste' and 'dire à madame'
then.ifNotEngaged: More puppet demonstrations and hands-on practice
then.ifOverwhelming: Simpler helping: just 'tu vas bien?' and get adult

lessons.realWorldConnection: Helping sad friends makes them feel better and makes us good friends

lessons.title: Mes stratégies émotionnelles
lessons.oneGoal: Students will identify their personal toolkit of strategies for managing different emotions

then.ifTooAdvanced: Focus on 2 simple strategies only
then.ifNotEngaged: More decoration time, peer sharing

lessons.realWorldConnection: Having our own emotion tools helps us handle feelings anywhere we go

lessons.title: Mon journal des émotions
lessons.oneGoal: Students will create their emotions journal showing their learning and strategies

then.ifTooAdvanced: Focus on 2 simple pages with lots of support
then.ifNotEngaged: More stickers and decoration, less content pressure

lessons.realWorldConnection: Our emotional journal reminds us of our skills and shows how much we've grown

lessons.title: Émotions en musique
lessons.oneGoal: Students will explore emotions through music and songs

then.ifTooAdvanced: Simple listening and basic movements only
then.ifNotEngaged: More instruments, more participation
then.ifOverstimulating: Quieter music, fewer instruments, more structure

lessons.realWorldConnection: Music helps us express feelings and feel better when we're upset

familyConnections.unitLetter:
Chers parents et familles,

Nous sommes ravis de commencer notre nouvelle unité: "Mes émotions et sentiments"

Cette unité permettra à votre enfant de:
• Explorer des concepts importants en formation personnelle et sociale
• Développer du vocabulaire en français
• Pratiquer de nouvelles compétences
• Faire des connexions avec la vie quotidienne

Quelques thèmes que nous explorerons:
Qu'est-ce que je ressens?, Mon visage montre mes émotions, Mon corps ressent aussi, Toutes les émotions sont normales, Dire mes sentiments

Comment vous pouvez aider à la maison:
• Demandez à votre enfant de partager ce qu'il/elle a appris
• Pratiquez le nouveau vocabulaire ensemble (voir la liste ci-jointe)
• Essayez les activités suggérées quand vous avez du temps
• Célébrez les efforts et les progrès, pas seulement les résultats

Pratiquez l'identification des émotions ensemble à la maison.

N'hésitez pas à me contacter si vous avez des questions ou si vous souhaitez partager des ressources culturelles liées à cette unité.

Le bien-être émotionnel est la base de tout apprentissage!

Cordialement,
[Nom de l'enseignant(e)]
